title: Monetary Authority of Singapore's Regulatory Oversight of Central Depository and its Obligations towards Individual Customers
what_it_is: Monetary Authority of Singapore's Regulatory Oversight of Central Depository and its Obligations towards Individual Customers

sections.label: CDP customer support expectations
sections.summary: MAS expects licensed institutions and CDP to treat customers fairly, with digital, call, self-help booth and in-person support options.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS expects all MAS-licensed financial institutions to treat their customers fairly, including availing effective support and feedback channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: At least 99% of all CDP's customers access its services digitally or over calls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since September 2022, less digitally-savvy customers can access self-help booths at CDP's SGX Vista premises to submit physical documents or seek in-person assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: They also have the option to book an in-person appointment with CDP via its customer hotline.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: CDP service representatives also take additional care by offering priority assistance or in-person meetings to customers who have previously indicated difficulties accessing its digital services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS expects CDP to address feedback about the adequacy of its non-digital customer support and closely monitor the performance of its customer service.

sections.label: Senior's CDP account restored
sections.summary: A senior who provided an email address was reminded to update particulars, warned before suspension, and has had his account restored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the specific case in point, from what I understand, the particular senior had provided an email address and therefore CDP had reminded the senior to update his particulars; and there was prior warning before account suspension.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have been dealing with that case and the senior's customer account has been restored.

sections.label: MAS engagement on customer pain points
sections.summary: MAS continues to engage CDP on customer pain points in in-person appointments and statements, and customers may request physical notices by post.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I want to assure Dr Tan that MAS continues to engage CDP, to address many of the customers' pain points across the user journey, particularly relating to those in in-person appointments and customer statements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, finally, if any particular customer wants a physical notice by post, he or she can also make that request and CDP will accede to it.
